---
title: "A new site for the WHOI CMIP data server"
date: 2026-11-05
author: Brett Longworth
categories: [news, site]
---

We are rebuilding the WHOI CMIP6 server. The new site replaces the old
search pages with a [dataset browser](../../../browse.qmd), an
[intake-esm catalog](../../../catalog.qmd) you can open from Python, and
[download instructions](../../../download-guide.qmd).

The holdings are also being reorganized into the standard CMIP directory
layout, and reanalysis products (ERA5 first) are being added.

The old site at cmip6.whoi.edu stays up until the new
one is ready. This preview runs on a sample catalog, so the datasets you see
are not real yet. Please [tell us](../../../report.qmd) what is missing or
confusing.
